title: Apple’s Chip Strategy Keeps Paying Dividends
summary: When Apple’s iPhone turned into an immediate hit upon its 2007 release, CEO Steve Jobs was quick to realize the value of designing and owning as many of the components in its devices as possible.  Since then, designing the main chips for all its devices has been a priority for  Apple  and a potent differentiator, enabling deeper integration between software, services, and hardware than any other consumer technology company.  This week’s release of iPhone 18 Pro and the A20 Pro chip inside of it, makes the advantages of Apple’s chip strategy as clear as day.
